Variants.Content: House Merlin is based in Pebble Town on Great Wyk Island and is a local lord and maritime vassal of the Iron Islands. Pebble Town has a port, fishing grounds and shipping routes to the Iron Fleet. Family members both run island estates and some serve on longships. Merlin’s family name is therefore connected to the land, sea breeze and warships at the same time; for the islanders, whether the lord can keep the granary, dock and family after the fleet voyages is more important than the title of a certain captain’s song at sea.

The Iron Islands nobles' assessment of Merlin would not be divorced from the authority of the Isles. If a family can provide reliable ships and kin support, it will be qualified to speak in the discussion; if it only relies on the name of its ancestors, people will soon forget it in the next king election.

The people of Merlin know the family from fishing nets, salt warehouses and docks. The glory of the Ironborn needs to be borne by craftsmen and farmers. If the lords only remember the voyage and the loot, the people on the island will see empty nets and empty warehouses first.
Entry Merlyn Entry Merlyn The family crest is just a facade, the real weight of the family is whether they can protect their fiefdom, honor their engagements, and rally people in times of crisis.
Entry Merlyn Entry Merlyn Family reputation ultimately comes down to specific people and specific orders.

Entry Merlyn Entry Merlyn The ancestors of a family can be praised, or they can become a shackles for future generations; the older the bloodline, the more old debts the successors are required to bear.
Entry Merlyn Entry Merlyn They may not remember the complete family tree, but they remember which family opened a granary in the winter and which family drove the refugees back into the snow.
